description: Source code for an audio resampler implementation, including class definition, methods for resampling audio data, and handling end-of-stream scenarios.

classes.name: AudioResamplerImpl
classes.description: CPU-based simple audio resampler implementation supporting resampling between same storage types and channels with different sample types.

methods.name: AudioResamplerImpl::Resample
methods.description: Resamples the input audio buffer and returns the resampled audio.

methods.name: AudioResamplerImpl::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream processing, producing any remaining resampled audio.
